common_instruction: Use the stated context; explain concrete behavior and do not claim tests were run without evidence.

cases.name: Nil slice vs API JSON
cases.prompt: A Go service represents an optional internal list and a JSON API response array. Should all slices be initialized to empty literals and all maps preallocated? Include whether nil is safe for reads and writes.
cases.trap: Applies a universal never-nil rule and changes JSON semantics accidentally.
expectations: Recognizes nil slices as idiomatic when nil is acceptable, while JSON array contracts may require an initialized empty slice.
Distinguishes nil map lookup (safe) from nil map assignment (panic).
must_not: Does not demand non-nil slices for every use.
